name: Pallid Egg
descriptionTemplate:
At turn start, both sides gain one stack of {Fervor}. Each stack of {Fervor} causes Active and {Tentacle DMG} dealt to inflict {Bleed} equal to 10% of the DMG dealt.
For every 20% of Boss HP reduced, all Awakeners gain 10 Aliemus.
At the start of battle, shuffle {Inspire Offsprings} and {Protect Offsprings} into the Draw Pile.
lore:
Pulses when the pale child is about to be born.
Be careful, they are coming soon.
